decisions.decision: Use Prisma + SQLite over JSON for database
decisions.rationale: Prisma abstracts the database layer, enabling seamless migration from SQLite to PostgreSQL by changing one line in schema.prisma. Provides type safety, migrations, and complex querying.
alternatives: JSON files — simpler but no migration path, no type safety, manual querying

decisions.rationale: Each page gets independent SEO metadata, OpenGraph tags, structured data. Near-instant navigation via prefetch. Simpler caching with ISR per-page.
alternatives: SPA — faster initial load but worse SEO, more client JS

decisions.rationale: Groups code by domain (projects, blog, admin, etc.) rather than by type (components/, hooks/, etc.). Scales better for large projects and allows independent feature development.
alternatives: Type-based — simpler for small projects but becomes disorganized at scale

decisions.decision: Build MCP adapter for Freebuff instead of waiting for native MCP
decisions.rationale: Freebuff's custom agent system allows building MCP integration immediately. The .agents/ directory structure supports this pattern natively.
alternatives: Wait for native MCP in Freebuff — uncertain timeline

decisions.decision: Use MCP memory server for cross-session persistence
decisions.rationale: The memory server's knowledge graph persists data to disk between sessions, providing a reliable store for project context across disconnected conversations.
alternatives: Local JSON files — manual, no graph structure

decisions.decision: Use Server Components as default, client components as leaves
decisions.rationale: Server Components eliminate client-side data fetching waterfalls. Client components only handle interactivity. Reduces bundle size and improves performance.
alternatives: All client components — simpler but more JS, worse performance

decisions.rationale: Animating transform and opacity is offloaded to the GPU compositor thread. Animating layout properties (width, height, top) triggers expensive reflows.
alternatives: CSS animations on any property — causes layout thrashing

techNotes.npxVsLocalInstall: MCP servers installed via npm (local) are more reliable than npx -y. Use `npm install @modelcontextprotocol/server-<name>` first, then configure the command to use local node_modules path.
techNotes.windowsCompatibility: On Windows, npx commands need cmd /c wrapper. The bridge script handles this automatically.
techNotes.zodIssue: Both filesystem and sequential-thinking MCP servers fail with ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND for zod/v4/core/index.js. This is a dependency resolution issue in the zod package.
